Axiom: Any edit → another isolated post-edit review dispatch mandatory, no exception of the agent's own making — "the fix is trivial" does not waive it; edits may create contradictions detectable only by a post-edit sensor pass. Whether a dispatch continues an existing worker or starts a fresh one belongs to the owning review step, not this global rule. The verdict handed to the operator MUST be the literal verdict text of the LAST dispatch actually run, shown as a direct quote — never a paraphrase, and never the verdict of a dispatch that was skipped.
